sloka: ततो हरिजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।विवृत्य नयने कोपान्मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा ।। ५.२१.९।।।।
transliteration: tato harijaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।vivṛtya nayane kopānmārjārasadṛśekṣaṇā ।। 5.21.9।।।।

translations.english: "Are there no pious men around or are you not heeding their words? Your mind is perverted and inclined to commit a forbidden act.
